approvers: Owner/director signs; client or developer would have to accept the cost
reason: The aluminium already arrives with factory film and I buy the cheapest thing that is good enough. At about €19 per m2 this is far above film and tape, and nobody is paying me extra for it.
objection: €19 per m2 against well under €1 per m2 for film and tape. A new supplier, a new budget line and a 150 m2 minimum for a small house job makes no sense.
instead: Keep the factory film and add tape and cheap protection film where needed, and make the trades take care.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to film and tape cost, or a client or developer who agrees in writing to pay for it as a line item.
